metadata.title: Culantro and Dried fish Chutney
metadata.description:
I did some research after I shot the video and came to know that 'Naga Dhania' in English is actually called Culantro or Mexican coriander. It's not much know outside the Indo-Caribbean and Hispanic communities. Apparently even in India it's used only in handful of states. Apart from the Northeastern states, it's used only in Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and in Andaman Nicobar islands. 

Culantro tastes like a stronger version of Coriander or Cilantro. It's mostly used in marinating meat. It has amazing health benefits and is used for various ailments ranging from constipation to infertility.

This chutney is prepared by pounding roasted dried fish with culantro leaves and has an amazing pungent smell and taste to it. It goes really well as a side with meals.
